sum: BioLineRx Ltd., a biopharmaceutical company, develops and commercializes therapeutics for oncology and rare diseases. The company's pipeline includes GLIX1, an oral, small molecule targeting DNA damage response in glioblastoma and other cancers; and APHEXDA (motixafortide), a peptide that is in Phase 1 clinical trial for the treatment of sickle cell disease, and Phase 2b clinical trial for the treatment of pancreatic cancer, as well as completed Phase 3 clinical trial for the treatment of multiple myeloma. It develops BL-5010, a pen-like applicator containing an acidic aqueous solution for the non-surgical removal of skin lesions. BioLineRx Ltd. was incorporated in 2003 and is headquartered in Hevel Modi'in, Israel.
ceo: Mr. Philip A. Serlin C.P.A., M.B.A. (Chief Executive Officer)
